Onboarding.ai_prompt:
Generate a NaviDash starter bookmark list for English-language users. Do not ask me to choose preferences first.

Balance these areas:
- Developer essentials: source hosting, technical communities, documentation, AI tools, and productivity tools
- Everyday entertainment: video, music, film, reading, communities, and lifestyle services

Requirements:
1. Recommend 24–36 representative global websites that are still operating, with a balanced mix of developer and entertainment services.
2. Prefer services with English interfaces that are widely used across multiple countries or regions.
3. Use only official homepages or stable entry points. Every URL must begin with http:// or https://. Remove duplicates and tracking parameters.
4. Use short, recognizable official English titles.
5. Put the final result in one code block marked text. Every line must strictly use this format: Title | full URL
6. Do not add numbering, category headings, blank lines, or explanations inside the block. Output nothing outside the block.

Format example only; the actual list must include more distinct websites:
```text
GitHub | https://github.com/
Stack Overflow | https://stackoverflow.com/
YouTube | https://www.youtube.com/
Spotify | https://open.spotify.com/
```
